headline: Sunday at the Lake: Warm sun with a chance of evening storms
lede: Sunday, September 20 brings mostly sunny skies and highs near 96°F before a chance of showers and thunderstorms moves in after dark. Perfect weather for a full day on Table Rock Lake or catching a matinee show.

featured.title: Branson Landing Fountain Show
featured.why: Free, family-friendly spectacle with lights, music, and water jets — a nightly highlight that never gets old.

plan.title: Early Lake Morning
plan.detail: Launch at sunrise for calm water and prime fishing before the weekend crowds arrive. Table Rock bite remains strong for bass near main lake points.

plan.title: Matinee Shows or Golf
plan.detail: Cooler indoor options like Legends in Concert or a round at Top of the Rock with stunning Ozark views.

plan.title: Landing Lights & Dinner
plan.detail: Catch the fountain show then enjoy lakeside dining — White River Fish House or a casual stop at Steamy Joe Cafe earlier in the day.

indoor.name: Legends in Concert
indoor.detail: 3 PM matinee tribute show — air-conditioned and family approved.
